title: 新加坡加强知识产权框架应对AI
titleEn: Singapore strengthens IP framework amid AI rise
summary: 新加坡审视知识产权框架，AI带来版权、专利和所有权问题。政府征求公众意见，探讨版权作品用于AI训练和AI创作的认可问题。
summaryEn: Singapore examines its IP framework as AI raises copyright and patent questions. The government seeks public feedback on using copyrighted works to train AI and recognizing AI-assisted creators.
speaker: CNA
